title: Bright, sparkly, nicely made costume jewelry. Perfect for little girls' playing dress up
text:
This is as good as it gets when you're talking about costume jewelry. The quality of the construction is very good. There are no rough spots on the surfaces of the bands inside or out. The pave set fake cubic zirconia chips are smooth and evenly set on the wedding band and it sits snugly into the grooves of the main ring. The platinum plating seems very bright over the sterling - hopefully it won't tarnish with wear.

The main ring looks bigger than it really is at first and I guess that's the point if you're wearing this in public. The wave look of the shoulders on the main ring are a nice visual touch and definitely add to the sparkle and shine factor. However, because of this design feature, the ring is not sizeable - though at this price point, you can buy another one if you lose this one, it is just faux lab created stones. I got this for my niece to wear when she visits me - she loves going through my jewelry box and playing dress up. She is now the perfect age to have something pretty and sparkly to start her very own little jewelry box at my house this year.

title: Keeps Dresser Clutter-Free
text: The AmazonBasics Four-Tier Jewelry Tree Stand in White/Brass is just what I needed to keep the jewelry that I wear on a daily basis up and off my dresser.  It makes things look neater and clutter free.  While most of my jewelry is carefully placed in dust bags and in boxes, there are times when I either wear the same jewelry multiple days in a row and putting these things away all the time is annoying, but I also want them to stay dust free and my dresser clutter free.  This jewelry stand does just that for me.  It's a wood base with four-tiered arms. The arms screw in from the bottom.  You'll need a phillips head screwdriver.  But that's it.  It immediately cleared my dresser and everything looks neater.  I wouldn't put my jewelry on this all the time and always because of tarnishing and exposure, but like I said it's good when you're wearing the same necklace for several days and then swap out the next necklace or bracelet.  The shortest tier has holes for earrings. I don't have pierced ears (for health reasons) so I can't utilize that part of it, but I use for bracelets and a watch and it's just fine.  I'm pleased with it so far.

title: Basic Bag with Handle Hassles
text: Every frequent traveller needs a good basic spinner bag. While this one hits the basic, handle hesitancy makes it less than desireable. at first glance it is the standard black spinner. there is a zip pocket on the outside and hard plastic handles on the bottom side and top. The interior is lined in thin gray polyester material. there are two zipped  pockets and straps with which to secure the contents. All the zippers, interior and exterio, worked smoothly. The bottom of the bag has four casters. Initially it did not spin, but only travelled forward and back. However after running it up and down the paved driveway, it spun like an Olympic ice skater. which brings me to the telescoping handle. PUsh a button to extend. There is only one extended position and push to return . Or at least that is how it is supposed to work. the handle is not responsive. It takes a couple of tries to get it up and a couple more to get it down. I thought it would loosen up like the casters but it hasn't. Sometimes it stick in the halfway position. . I suspect that eventually it will not move at all or be stuck in one position or the other. This renders it trustworthy for airport use. (Trust me. I had a handle break on a brand new piece of expensive luggage and it was no fun hauling it through multiple airports.) So while I appreciate the generous capacity of  this 29 inch bag, the smooth running casters and sturdy zippers, the handle hassles make it  a no for me.

title: Gold Plated Sterling Silver Hammered Hoop.
text: These were pretty, but really cheap.  They are suppose to be Sterling Silver, but don't test as such.  There is a really heavy charge in the metal.  There was also a piece of bent metal at the top of the post that was a real turn off for me.  I had a hard time trying to fasten them and noticed the area they hook into was closed, so I opened it slightly just to close the earring trying them on.  I really wasn't happy with the quality and knowing they really weren't Sterling.  It isn't that Sterling is a real fine metal, but when it is marked for Sterling, that is what you expect.  I absolutely sure these came from China because I recognize the quality and am never happy.  They have a real tough time getting Sterling Silver because the guy who sells the pieces sells in bulk and if you don't take them all, you don't get any.  So some of the buyers don't speak up even when they know the item isn't Sterling.  I have had numerous discussions about the problem.  I don't think Amazon purposely knew this and just because something is stamped doesn't mean a thing.  Anyone can buy a stamp and stamp their own jewelry, so don't take it for gospel.  I  own 2 stores and protect my buyers, so I don't always test, but some times I do when flags go up to tell me I should.  Little signs, but enough to get me to test and I don't care to have to, but you do what you feel you need to because it will come back to haunt you if you don't.  I'm not a huge Business and have much more to loose.  So for $19.99, I'm returning it because I know I could find better cheaper than that.

title: Didn't Pass the Disney Test
text:
We took this little piece of luggage for a spin to Disney World. It did not perform well.

First, the good. It's small and compact. It has a collapsible handle and four wheels that roll in all directions. That's also one of the problems with it.

The luggage is almost too small for its size. You can fit larger carry-ons (I had a discussion with a steward about carry-on size) and this one is so small that you're actually not taking up as much space as you might need for an overnight trip.

It has just one handle on the right side, so it only really fits one way into the overhead compartment -- with the wheels facing into the other luggage. There are definitely situations where you might want to turn the carry-on the other way (some compartments have a shelf that juts out, for example).

The wheels are the worst though. Using a spinner carry-on with a telescoping handle is a delicate balance of leverage. I could never get it to roll smoothly, and that's because for the telescoping handle to work in conjunction with the carry-on, it needs to be significantly weighted down. I thought maybe things would go smoother on the return trip, but even loaded with Disney loot it still wasn't heavy enough to make rolling the carry-on practical.

It's certainly durable, but the advantages it offers (spinning wheels, telescoping handle) are outweighed by better options like backpacks and larger carry-ons.

title: Product come as expected.
text:
Last time I bought diamond was 11 yrs ago, when I purchased an engagement ring. This time I buy this pair of ear rings for our anniversary.

As with any diamond purchases, one have too many choices over Carat/Color/Clarity and it' was a little bit difficult to find what I wanted. Eventually I bought this pair after some research and thinking: start with the given budget and color/clarity requirement: Typically ear rings use lower color/clarity diamonds compared to engagement rings; so I don't go to DEFG color or VVS/VS. I also don't want to go any further below J or SI . In my opinion, gems need to carry some beauty /rareness factors to be called "Gems". Diamonds below J or SI could be called near-gems. With these requirement and my budget, 3/4 cttw is the size available, which is actually pretty good for a pair of earrings that will be put on everyday.

title: and held up great! A couple tips
text:
as a backpacker and hiker I know that packing cubes, space wise, are inefficient, they don't optimize space. But when I took a month trip to Europe, living out of a backpack, organization was key. These cubes were cheap, and held up great!

A couple tips:
1) if you are using a slim duffle or backpack: try slipping them in on there side (handles facing you) and put a piece of tape identifying what you have in each cube for quick and easy access.
2) I cut two pieces of cardboard the shape of the square, placed one on the bottom laid in my nicely folded dress clothes, and placed the other on top. this kept my dress clothes flat and wrinkle free despite being in a compressed pack.

text: We tried out both the men's and women's Amazon Essentials water shoe to use at the outdoor pool next summer. I wear a size 12 in women's shoes so the 11-12s ran a bit small for me which means they run true to size. The shoes fit me once I got them on however I have a lymphedema swollen foot so the shoe was a bear to get on as the fabric is not stretchy whatsoever.  My husband wears a size 12-13 in men's shoes, the men's size 13 fit him GREAT.  There's no ankle support such as in Ryka water aerobics shoes, these are simply your basic water shoes that are perfect for wearing to the public pool. Both pairs of shoes are made with quality construction and materials that should last several years of fairly heavy summer pool use. The most important thing - no risk of burning the feet on the hot pool deck which is a serious problem in the heat of the summer! and greatly reduces the risk of stubbing toes on the bottom water drains which we have a time or two before getting these water shoes. 5 stars on each, highly recommend!

title: These Small Packing Cubes Are Top-Notch and So Convenient For Packing and Staying Organized During Travel
text:
*VINE CUSTOMER REVIEW OF FREE PRODUCT*

I've heard how convenient packing cubes are for awhile now, but this is my first set. I don't know what I ever did without them! These are so convenient for organizing all those small items that I go crazy digging through my suitcase looking for while I'm on vacation- which only gets more annoying as my trip progresses and my suitcase gets more disorganized. The small size cubes are perfect for so many things like socks, underwear, tank tops, T-shirts, lingerie, swimwear, loungewear, pjs, toiletries, slippers, shoes and even medications. I can fit a surprising amount in one small cube. For example, one small cube easily fits 6 rolled T-Shirts, which look wrinkle-free when I unpack them. Although compact, each cube can even be used to pack a whole outfit for a day.

I love that this set of four small cubes weighs next to nothing. The mesh top is wonderful as I can easily see what's in each cube, and anything damp (like a swimsuit) can still air out if damp when it's time to repack. The zippers are high quality and have easy to grip plastic pull tabs, and each cube even has a little carrying handle. These cubes are also perfect for separating clean from used undergarments and other clothing items during travel. On top of all that, these cubes are machine washable. These AmazonBasics cubes are really well-made and a super convenient travel item that's definitely worthy of 5 stars!

title: A Great Umbrella for the Wet Season
text:
Pros
+Compact Design
+Excellent Build Quality
+Comfy Handle
+Strong Umbrella
Cons
-Pop up action could be a potential problem
-Good, but not excellent, wind resistant.
-Plain Design

Should you buy: Yes
Actual Value: $20
AmazonBasics has always surprised me in that they provide a variety of products that are not only useful, but high quality and rivals and even beats the price of some other products. This umbrella is no exception and my expectations were high. Unsurprisingly, this is one of the best and most affordable umbrellas I’ve ever used.

-Design-

This is a no frills basic umbrella, so there isn’t much to talk about in terms of design. However, there are some small, subtle details that I appreciate Amazon added to it. For instance, the handle has a comfortable design and it is covered in soft touch plastic that adds a premium feel that you don’t find from a plastic handle. There isn’t much in the way of Amazon branding apart from the strap that holds the umbrella together when folded. It is also very compact, which makes it small enough to carry anywhere, such as in the car, in a bag, or in a backpack. But it is still large enough to cover 2 small people or, in my case, one big guy.

-Function-

The umbrella has a nice open/close button that works as advertised and opens the bag with a satisfying amount of force and closes the umbrella that makes it easy to fold. Granted, while this is a convenient addition, it does look like something that could potentially be a problem in the future. But for now, it is nice to use. The fabric used for the umbrella itself is great and water doesn’t leak and water flows nicely away. The construction itself is good and the frame feels really sturdy. I used it in the brief storm that we have right now in Los Angeles and it does resist the winds fairly well. However, it does feel like anything stronger than the winds that are outside right now will destroy it. Nevertheless, this is still great for this umbrella, especially given its price. Just don’t expect it to handle hurricane level winds.

-Conclusion-

I’ve used a couple of umbrellas that were in this price range that were flimsy and didn’t last more than a month. But this umbrella sets the new standard for cheap umbrellas that should be enough for most, if not all, people who don’t want to get wet in the rain. And with the wet season fast approaching, there has never been a perfect time to purchase an umbrella. Definitely a top pick for me and AmazonBasics once again delivers a great product.

title: A worthwhile purchase, but get the sizes you need
text: I had never heard of packing cubes before, but I bought two sets on a whim along with my [[ASIN:B0711F4437 AmazonBasics Hardside Spinner Luggage - 28-inch, Navy Blue]]. I like them! I recently lived out of the suitcase for two weeks while overseas, and the packing cubes definitely made it much easier to keep a big suitcase neat, organized and manageable. I opted for two four-piece sets, one of all medium cubes and one of four different sizes--small, medium, large and slim. This combination worked well for me with the large suitcase, with just one of the medium cubes sitting the trip out. Some reviewers seem to describe the large cube as shockingly huge, but I don't perceive it that way at all. I used the large one to hold two stacks of five men's shirts, size medium (see my photos). As far as I'm concerned the large cube isn't big enough to comfortably hold even one men's suit. I just took my suit folded around its hanger, complete with its zippered cover. I used one medium cube for underwear, one for rolled-up T-shirts, one for pants, and one for more shirts and shorts (yes, I tend to overpack). I love how they organize your clothes and allow you to pack more into a smaller space, leaving room for souvenirs, and allowing TSA to check your luggage without handling all your stuff. I've used baggies on military deployments and these are far and away better although they aren't waterproof, so for military deployments I would still recommend baggies. This luggage fits surprisingly more than you’d expect. Packing modestly, I was able to fit 6 days worth of outfits into it, plus additional clothing and items purchased abroad upon my return.

text:
This is a high-quality bag for a reasonable price. Everything works, survived 3 round-trip flights in pretty good shape. All wheels still intact.

UPDATE April 2022

Preparing for an international flight, I closed this bag and locked it, but could not get it open again with the 3-digit code I had set and used several times. I was frantic. My flight time was approaching, so I decided to take it to that airport and ask TSA to open it.

Fortunately, a kind airport security agent analyzed the code for the lock (they have ways) and opened it. The code he saw in the tumblers was one digit off from the one I had set. One of the tumblers had moved.

He said that somehow I must have reset the code. I don’t see how that could have happened. After I used it for my last trip, I opened it with my code and put it in storage with those digits showing. They were still showing as I packed the bag this time. I did not go through the reset steps, all I did was close the bag and the locks.

These things are buggy. Won't be buying one of these again.

title: Convenient, fit standard carry on bag, hold a surprising number of shirts and slacks (but not many sweaters and sweat shirts).
text:
My husband and I travel a lot including in a travel trailer that has no storage for clothing. We live out of our suitcases a lot!

This review is for the small, medium and large size bags.

I bought these cubes to help organize the main compartment of a suitcase and carry on bag with the idea of being able to lift the cubes in and out and use them somewhat like dresser drawers rather than always having to dig through the entire suitcase to get out what I want then repack everything that was on top of it. They will let me pack "like with like" keeping "every day clothes" separate from "dressy" clothes and my tops separate from my slacks and skirts.

PROS:
1. The cubes collapse down and fold up to store inside the suitcase when not in use.
2. They have mesh sides, so they breathe.
3. The cubes are just the right size to fit entirely across (large size) or two side-by-side (medium size) in a standard carry on bag.
4. The small cubes are a good size for packing socks, bathing suits, etc.
5. The medium and large bags hold a surprising number of shirts, tops, slacks. How many depends on the size of the person's clothes, of course. (See cons).

CONS:
1. The cubes are 3" (medium) and 4" (large) thick, so although they help organize clothes and act as dresser drawers, and they fit a lot of regular tops and slacks, they are too thin to fit more than one or two sweaters, sweat shirts, jackets, towels, etc. Those really need to be packed singly.

title: Sturdy, Ergonomic, Lightweight Travel Companion
text:
If you're a frequent traveler, this suitcase might be your new best friend. It's resilient, spacious, and comfortable to carry and wheel around. On top of that, it will keep your luggage safe and secure.

Outside Design: The sturdy hardshell design does a fantastic job of protecting your items, and it stands up to ordinary rough handling well, from my experience so far. You might expect the suitcase to be heavy with this tough shell, but it's actually very lightweight, even more so than other similarly-sized (soft) suitcases I've owned. This may be, in part, because the suitcase handles so well and is so ergonomic. The red (really more of a maroon) color is nice, too, because it's attractive yet different enough from the average suitcase that you can easily identify it on a carousel.

Handling: With a comfortable handle on top for carrying and a telescoping handle for pulling, this suitcase is easy to take with you. The sturdy swiveling wheels add to the easy maneuverability.

Security: With a built-in TSA lock, you can relax knowing that your luggage is secure. [You set the combination, which locks your suitcase, but the TSA is still able to search your luggage if necessary.]

Inside Design: The suitcase has two main zippers, including a regular one and one that expands the storage capacity enough to fit a fair amount of extra clothing. There's plenty of room inside, along with adjustable straps to secure your belongings. Another zippered compartment in the top half adds extra organization and storage space. There's also a decent-sized mesh pocket, a waterproof pocket, and a removable pouch (fastened with a snap) that folds up into a little pouch inside the suitcase. In terms of organization, I find all of these components quite nice.

Overall, I love this suitcase, and I expect it to stand up to plenty of travel!

title: Stylish, flexible, operates as expected.  Excellent value.
text:
This is a very good hard shell suitcase with handles on the end and sides for carrying in addition to a telescoping handle, 360-degree spinning casters, and hard, scratch-resistant sides. My review is for the 28" size, a fairly large suitcase.

There is plenty of room inside and the design includes retaining straps, dividers, zip pockets (including a small pocket for toiletries, etc. at the hinge). You have some flexibility as to storage, particularly in a suitcase of this size -- you can really pile up the clothing/shoes in the lower portion while packing and the top will easily accommodate them if you haven't stuffed the top divided zip pockets in the lid. All the zippers work well and appear to be sturdy. The stitching looks good inside and out and I didn't notice any obvious flaws or poor construction. Solid!

The wheels operate flawlessly and I'm able to drag this suitcase along with no trouble. The telescoping handle is adjustable and the button works well although fully extended there is a bit of lateral travel in its slots. Empty, the suitcase is light and carrying it with the side handle depends upon how full it is and how heavy the items are, obviously. This 28" model is large enough that I probably wouldn't want to carry it through an airport but picking it up to put it into a car makes such a handle essential. These carry handles pop in and out and are normally flush with the suitcase surface.

The exterior is handsome complete with faux leather trim and matching plastic. It looks more expensive than it is. Best of all, it is strong enough to protect, flexible enough to handle a couple's different needs, well-made enough to last (though I've only owned it a little while and haven't really tested its longevity -- it appears well-made), and priced right.

Overall, a strong contender from Amazon. Thanks!

text:
I see a lot of complaints here about rhodium plating. Let's clear things up. Rhodium is a precious metal. Recovered as a byproduct of mining for other metals such as gold or platinum.
Rhodium doesn't really affect scratch resistance as the plating thickness is insufficient. Rhodium Plating over sterling Silver makes the Jewelery more durable, shinier, resistant to tarnishing, gives a more plush white metal feel so rhodium plated over sterling silver is better than just sterling silver. Rhodium plating is what gives it that shiny metallic look. Do not use sterling silver cleaner on rhodium plated sterling silver. Just use warm mild soapy water. Wipe and dry ,Just saying, love the necklace 👍🏼❗️

The chain length is great fashion-wise but I am considering getting a slightly longer chain as the one that comes with the locket doesn't allow me to look at the photos easily while I'm wearing it. title: You get what you pay for...
text:
I generally am a fan of AmazonBasics!

This wasn't a good experience for me. The umbrella looks good and initially seems fine... but there are some huge flaws in the design.

PROS:
- Cheap
- Waterproof
- Looks good

CONS:
- This umbrella could not handle wind at all.
- Flawed pole design. (The design is weirdly backwards for the main pole in the middle of the umbrella. The part that is near your hand is the thinnest part...and it gets larger and heavier towards the top. This causes a weird balance and makes the umbrella feel not sturdy.)
- It feels cheap.
- It is tiny. I recognize it may be my fault for not knowing what "travel" umbrellas are... but this was incredibly small. I'm not even sure if it would help most people outside of just saving your hair from getting wet.

So, yeah... generally I like Amazon's products but this one sadly didn't hold up. I think I will be shopping for umbrellas in person from now on.

It was hard to realize this would be the case without trying it on. I will seek out a larger, heavier, opaque, heart that is a bit more intense in color. However, please note that this is very satisfactory to many customers and if this is what you want, go for it. The only real "problem" with it if you like the look in real life is that it may stick to your skin in odd places rather than handing straight down. When my toddler son flushed my authentic studs down the toilet, I was heartbroken (and glad I had them insured). Knowing it could happen again, and knowing I just couldn't justify paying $2.5-$3k for earrings now that I have 2 kids that will some day need to go to college- I realized my best alternative was to buy a really good quality pair of CZs. I do think these are beautiful... better than most CZs I've seen in stores. And for $19- I mean, you can't expect perfection! I definitely think that they're worth up to like, $100... so it's a good deal. It's just not a real diamond ;)

I got the 1 ct so they'd be identical to the ones I lost- but also because I thought going too big would be obviously fake. But when I opened them up I was just kind of underwhelmed. I wish they sold a 1.5ct, I think that's as big as you could pull off without feeling like a phony. But hey, at this price point, I might as well buy the 2 ct (so they're 1 ct each) even though a that size they could look really fake since they're "flawless" unlike real diamonds. I mean, a pair of real 2ct studs would be about $8.5k... and I'm not going to even pretend that I would spend that on my ears at this "life stage" (small kids)

Packaging wasn't as shown but that's ok!

title: Good casual business shoes
text:
I put the shoes squarely in the middle of the pack. They work is expected and I'm happy with them but they aren't outstanding in any regard.

Everything about them is perfectly acceptable for the price.
+ I usually wear a 9 1/2 for the most comfort and these fit me pretty much as expected. If you have wide feet, maybe think twice before purchasing.
+ The suede finish is pleasant and seems like it will hold up over time
+ The soles are not overly slippery for this style and they don't squeak (so far?) when walking across linoleum
+ The inside is nicely padded and comfortable. The edges of the heel do not rub against me unpleasantly.

So, yeah. For the price they're great. If you're used to cheaper shoes I think you'll be happy. If you're comparing them to multi-hundred dollars shoes, you'll find them a little lacking in style and ultimate comfort. Personally? No regrets wearing these aroung.

title: Perfect for a backpack
text:
I ordered a set of slim and small packing cubes (Sky Blue) for our new Tocode packpack which was also purchased on Amazon. We will be taking our bikes on a ferry to Mackinac Island for an over night stay. The backpack will be our luggage.

Anyone who has used a backpack as luggage knows that things get lost down in the depth. The Tocode BP measures 12"W x 7"D x 18"H. So finding these packing cubes that fit inside the BP is just what we needed. (Tocode doesn't give the size in liters for this BP, but based on others with similar dimensions I am guessing they are 28-30L.)

Here is how we intend to use them in the BP. Two of the slim cubes fit side by side in the back largest compartment of the BP. Just be sure to face the mesh away from any inside zippers the BP has. See photo. One of the small cubes fits inside the middle compartment easily. Again there is a key fob inside and you don't want your keys tangled in the mesh.

For the photos I only put some hand towels in the cubes. There was plenty of space left for packing more.

Overall, we think these will work great for our up coming trip to the Island and for future trips.

title: Pleasantly surprised by this diminutive case
text: I got the 18" luggage and while my initial thought was that it would be too small to be of any use, I was pleasantly surprised.  My husband was able to use it for a business-casual overnight trip and was *just* able to fit all his belongings (a single change of clothes, pjs, and toiletry kit).  I'm thinking it may be a tad small for some women to get away with as an overnight bag, but certainly not impossible.  It's a great size for compliance with increasingly strict airline regulations.  The internal packing space is approximately 13"x13" (length x width), as the two long sides of the bag have a slight 'give' to them.  Aside from the telescoping handle, there are handles on both the top and side of the bag.  The zippers operate smoothly, as do the wheels.  There are two internal zipper pockets in addition to the single exterior one.  The fabric seems fairly rugged and the overall construction appears sturdy.  It's definitely comparable to some more expensive suitcases I've owned in the past; I recommend giving it a chance.

title: These Ruby Earrings are stunning! Detailed review.
text:
These Ruby Earrings are absolutely beautiful. I bought these to match my Ruby Cross Pendant and Ruby Ring. And the color is a Pinkish Red yet it is Red enough for me. It goes with my red outfits, pink outfits, purple outfits, black outfits and white outfits.

Pros:
1) Size of these earrings...while these are dainty, in my opinion, the size is just right. Please see pictures below.

2) Clarity/Sparkle of Stones. I give this a 10 out of 10 for both Clarity and Sparkle.

3) Color of these created Ruby Stones. Even though it is a lighter red color with some pinkish hue to it, I am personally delighted with the color. My pictures show the color as I wanted you to see the reddish/pinkish color.

4) Size of Stones and how it shows up on my ears...I took a picture of the earrings and then pictures of the earrings on my ear. I am pleased with the size as personally I did not find them too small.

5) These earrings are secure, and stay on well. I even wear them while I sleep and shower.
This is very important as the leverback clasps are sturdy and well made.

6) How they show on ears...So I have very short blonde hair so these earrings really show well on my ears.
If you have long hair and pull your hair away from your ears, then they should show up well.

***How to put on these earrings:

When you put these on each ear, take your time. It is best to look in a mirror in well lighter room. Angle the front part to make sure it fits into you ear fully. Then push the earrings to lock it.
Note: I have rather thick earlobes but they fit my ears well.

These earrings look classy and somewhat expensive...I highly recommend them.

title: The finish cheapens it; clasp is difficult
text:
I don’t buy a lot of sterling these days. But as girl in the South who grew up in the 80s, sporting “James Avery” sterling silver dangle-rings was a must. (And if you were lucky, you had a charm bracelet too.) These pieces of mine lasted decades; they had the amazing dark patina I associate with silver. But this bracelet is SO FRIGGIN SHINY. Blindingly so. When I go into the bathroom at 2am this thing works like a nightlight on my wrist—it practically glows. High polish is one thing, but this is…I don’t know, almost disturbingly bright. Perhaps this just how sterling is these days? I’m hoping that w/ a lot of wear and eventual oxidation, this will achieve a more normal sheen rather than a full-on glare. While cleaning off tarnish is a pain in the butt, I don’t think this glinty diamond-like shine, clearly over coated with some such chemical or another, is ideal either. For reference, my pic shows this bracelet at the top of my hand next to other sterling, gunmetal, and just plain old ‘silver tone’ metals.

I’m going to keep it because it’s hard to find bracelets that don’t swallow me since I have a 5-3/4” wrist. I ordered the 7” and it’s a bit too big but not uncomfortably so. I’m grateful it measured accurately. High points there.

Quality wise the teensy ‘beads’ are decently made; the 5 rows give it an appearance of mesh. It’s pretty lightweight too, not at all heavy—which isn’t necessarily a good thing if this is solid SS, but it makes for comfy daily wear. My biggest gripe, even more so than how dang shiny this looks, is the difficulty of the clasp. I try to avoid jewelry I can’t fasten myself. And I struggle a LOT to put this on; it’s really awkward and I hate yelling for my husband to help me out. And I don’t love the side-eye I get from my pets’ judging me for the stream of profanities. Once finally fastened, it IS secure though. Considering the moderate price point, it’s an anemic recommend… unless you are even more bothered by fake-y shine than I am.

title: Lower quality than expected
text:
These were larger than I expected (which is not why I gave three stars). The largest of them completely covers the bottom of a 20" carry-on sized suitcase. Not sure how that will be very useful except possibly to use to separate clean from dirty clothes. And the "smallest" of them is a strange long rectangle that is way too big for something like first aid or even for corraling your electronics adapters and cords. It's just really not a useful shape at all. There are none that are "cubic". I have to own up to the fact that if I'd bothered to get out a ruler I could have known the size issues in advance and so I'm pointing it out more for other people than as a justification for three stars.

The reason I gave them three stars is the quality of the fabric. It's extremely thin nylon-feeling fabric almost more like a sleeping bag stuff sack. I wish I'd purchased from Eagle Creek or one of the better-known companies. But I don't have time before my trip to do that. I don't recommend purchasing these. They're not worth the money.

title: Super cute and comfortable ballet flat.
text:
*EDIT*: After 3.5 months, they’re starting to fall apart. The glue is deteriorating and the outer sole is coming off. Easy to fix with some good glue, but I guess the quality of these shoes are not as great as I first thought. I wore them 3-4 times a week to work. I have a desk job, and don’t walk around too much so this is unacceptable. I will probably purchase again just because they’re comfortable and fits my foot well, but I’ll make sure to rotate with other shoes so as to not make them wear down so quickly.
Original review:
I was pleasantly surprised with these black ballet flats! I’ve had nothing but bad experiences with almost every single Amazon brand item I’ve bought (dog pads, clothing, underwear, trash bags, etc.). They were all crap quality. However after my previous black flats got damaged at work, I needed a new pair ASAP and didn’t have time to go to the shoe store or mall. Amazon delivers quickly and would be easy to return if I hated them so I took the chance. They fit true to size, and they are very comfortable! I’ve been careless a few times and scraped the toe and heel of the shoe against very rough surfaces and I still don’t have a single scratch! Very durable material that is easy to wipe clean! They stay shiny and keep their shape too. They look brand new even after nearly 2 months of daily wear. The only thing I HATE is that the inside of the shoe insole has “Amazon Essentials” stamped in a huge and ugly font right smack dab in the middle which makes it look extremely tacky. text:

Both shoes are suffering this separation, one worse than the other.

Sure, you buy $15 shoes for kids, you get $15 worth of shoes. But relative to a name brand like Vans, you can pay about $10 more and get shoe that will last MUCH longer. This generic Amazon brand shoe lasted a bit more than a month. I threw them in the trash this afternoon.

BTW- don't be fooled by that little line embossed into the top edge of the rubber sole all the way around. Makes it look like stitching would be there. Nope. No stitching holding sole to the upper. Just poor-quality epoxy.

title: Nice Looking Belt. Leather Like Material.
text: My wife only has a few belts, and not near as many as I've noticed her friends have.  It's really never been a big deal to her, but I like her to have things, especially the little things that make her happy.  A new belt is one of those little things that puts a smile on her face.  This looks almost exactly like one she bought a few months ago, and never got to wear because I destroyed it (I'll get to that in a bit).  For the moment, I'll tell you about this belt.  I ordered this for her, and was especially happy that this one had the holes all the way across the belt.  She likes that look, and loves a brown leather belt to wear with her jeans.  She loved this when it arrived, she noticed immediately how much it looked like the one she had just bought, and her man turned it into a strap to hold the lid on the garbage can (not actually, but close).  This belt is made from 66% Polyurethane and 34% Leather, which is funny to me, because I just used Polyurethane to protect the kitchen cabinets I just painted, and couldn't figure out why the same product is in my wife's new belt.  I didn't know this, but apparently Polyurethane is used on faux leather, including belts, to give them the most realistic looking imitation leather possible, making faux leather feel like real leather, and give it's overall appearance almost identical to real cowhide.  When faux leather is made with Polyurethane, when it's stitched, gathered, or tufted it actually “breaks” or wrinkles like real leather.  Because there are no plastic pellets used in faux leather, there is no cracking or peeling, and it remains soft and supple for quite a long time, most likely more time than the belt will ever be used.  Finally, Polyurethane is used over vinyl (or plastic) because it is considered to be a friendlier product to the Earth.  Poly doesn't contain any dioxins, which, some may know, is an extremely serious environmental pollutant, and something our planet hardly needs any more of.  Although Poly infused faux leather costs less than real leather, it is more expensive to produce than when using plastics.  Which may help you when you are trying to justify prices of faux leather vs the real thing.  Now you know, as do I, why Polyurethane is an ingredient of any faux leather belt.  The next time someone looks at a faux leather belt like this and asks why there's Poly in it, you'll sound like an Einstein telling them exactly why.  When you see this belt in person, you'll realize that this process works, and it is hard to tell from the real thing.  My wife couldn't tell the difference, even when she put a real leather belt right up next to it.  The only time I think you can really tell is when you compare an old faux leather piece to an old real leather piece.  Old leather has a look that I don't think faux leather can make, but we're talking about a length of time that most women will never see on this belt.  My wife loves this belt, faux or not, and is extremely happy that the belt I took and destroyed, and looked almost exactly like this, was now a distant memory.  And, getting to why I destroyed her new faux leather belt a few months ago, and something I learned about faux leather.  Unlike real cowhide (real leather that belts are almost always made from), faux leather is made in layers, and finished with a faux leather appearance.  But, if you sliced a faux leather belt wide open, it would look nothing like the real thing.  My wife had asked me at the time, when she bought that belt, to add a hole to it where she needed it, making it more comfortable for her to close the buckle.  I thought no problem, took out my drill and bits, matched a bit to the other holes and ensured the hole would be the same size, and proceeded to drill.  Well, within a nano second, there was stuff coming out that hole, wrapping around my drill bit, and spewing out that hole like I just shot it at close range.  I had no idea it was gonna do that, couldn't believe I just killed her belt, and didn't know how I was gonna bring that dead belt carcass back to my wife and tell her I just killed her new belt, but it was a justifiable homicide, and I was pleading stupidity.  I'm only telling you this as a kind of a warning about faux leather belts.  Although they may look, act, and feel like the real thing, they are like the aliens in Men In Black.  They look exactly like you and me, until you remove the cover, and suddenly something terrifying is revealed (I know I'm kind of exaggerating here, just making a point you'll remember), so keep in mind to never add a hole to your faux leather belt.  The best part is, you'll never have to do this with this Amazon Essentials Fully Adjustable Casual Belt, with the holes pre-punched the entire length of the belt!  This is a great looking belt, and looks exactly like the real deal.  By adding this belt to your wardrobe, you'll not only be helping to save the planet, but adding a great look to your jeans.  Currently selling for just over $22 bucks (as of this review), I think it's an awesome bargain, $22 bucks for a well made, great looking, faux leather belt, and piece of mind knowing you didn't give mother nature any harmful chemicals buy purchasing a new belt.  An awesome looking belt, and well worth the money.

I also like the way the chain sort of weaves through the pendant rather than attaching at a ring on the top of the pendant like most necklaces.  The necklace I got for my birthday has the same design, and it seems to help the necklace lay flat. title: Realistic!
text: I was asked to review this product. Over the years I have been given many expensive pieces of jewelry, all of which I love! But I finally retired almost all of my expensive bracelets (that are left!) because I found that I was losing them all the time. I must be very hard on bracelets!! Then, we went on an out of country trip and my bags were two days behind us! Again, there I was troubling myself over the loss of expensive stuff!. After finally getting my purse stolen in Hawaii (of course my jewelry was in it because I didn't trust the safe in the hotel room) I said, enough! Either I lose my beloved pieces or they get stolen. When I received this ring I did a double take on its beauty. Wow, it looks so real! I thought that a simulated stone would look just like that, simulated. This ring has the sparkle of a real diamond and fits so comfortably. The smooth finish of the sterling silver is awesome. I am enjoying the compliments I get on it and it feels so nice on my hand. I certainly would hate to lose it but I am not going to fret about the cost of replacing it. I am going to look at other pieces from this company for traveling. We ladies like to accessorize but to get the same effect at a fraction of the price is very appealing. You ladies that love your diamonds will be impressed!

title: A well-made economically-priced umbrella
text:
This is a well-made umbrella that should be durable. If you have the Velcro wrap-around strap undone, you can snap it open by pressing the button. It will also partially close by pressing the same button while it is open but not all the way. You must press the center-outer-top down or push it against something like the floor or a post, for instance, to close it all the way. Like a lot of these type of umbrellas, it is difficult to get it back into the neat little storing sleeve it comes with, but the Velcro wrap-around strap does the job of making it compact and handy to carry. Also, I think the handle could have been bigger. It has a nice texture, but it would comfortably fit a child's hand, not an adult's hand.
Nevertheless a well-made, and economically-priced umbrella. Recommended.

text:

title: Necessity for travel with kids
text:
If you travel, and especially if you travel with children, you need these.

To be fair, I've owned the "name brand" versions of these, and the AmazonBasics versions work just as well. I have used them on a few trips so far and no issues with broken zippers, tears, seams coming apart, etc. I recommended them to a friend who bought them in different colors to color code each family member's items (which is BRILLIANT) and she doesn't know how she traveled without them before.

I use the largest size for my clothes, the medium size for my kids clothes, the small for their sock/underwear, and the long for my socks/underwear. We have multiple sets for longer trips. Somehow TSA always chooses my bag to randomly inspect (probably because it always weighs a ton, haha) and these cubes mean my bag is still organized at the end destination.

I've even started using the cubes to pack extra clothes for my kids in my day bag (my kids can get messy anywhere).

One of our best purchases for travel, hands down. If you are hesitating, don't. Buy these.

title: Great for travel, but will it hold up?
text:
Update over a year later ... still using the cubes and still love them!!! The bright blue has multiple loose strings but functionaly still works although I don't use one of the sizes for fear it will rip soon. All other colors holding up perfect. This after many trips and washing. Only 4 stars as 1 in 5 sets has issues.

I bought 5 of these 4 piece packing cubes for our family. All different colors. We were going on a long road trip, and these worked out great! The kids knew their colors and were able to find their own clothes without asking me. It was nice for one night stops as we just took a cube out of the car and left the rest of the stuff. My only issue is that one of the colors, the bright blue, already has some loose strings around the zipper. I don't know if it's that color or just luck of the draw. In particular, one of the cubes I don't think will last long. None of the other sets show any wear. I have washed them a few times and we used them on 2 different trips so far.
For those wondering how to use them, this is what we did. I packed the medium one with 5 days of summer clothes. The large one had an additional set of 4 days of clothes (incl undergarments), extra pajamas and 1 pair of jeans/pants. It varied per kid (due to clothing size), but the 2 small ones had socks/undergarments, pajamas, and a bathing suit. The large cubes we kept in the car until we were done with the smaller cubes. I wish you could buy individual sizes in specific colors as I would have liked to augment my husband and my cubes with another medium one. We needed just a bit more room (I kept our jeans and pajamas loose outside cubes). Also the big cube was too much room for my 7 yr old. At night I would just pile up each cube color and in the morning the kids knew they could pick whatever was in there. No asking for "where are my socks?". It does take a bit of planning but it was worth it!
All in all, I would definitely recommend, just keeping my fingers crossed on the longevity. For the manufacturer, I would recommend changing the tones of the blue cubes. In a suitcase, the light and dark blue look very similar and are hard to tell apart. And please add more colors - maybe purple.

title: NOT a Swarovski zirconia.
text:
Update to previous review below:
I received the second necklace that I purchased to see if it was a fluke that the first was not an actual Swarovski zirconia. The second necklace also has the made with Swarovski zirconia hang tag, but also did NOT have the laser inscription on the stone, indicating that it is NOT actually made with zirconia by Swarovski.

I purchased this necklace, and was really excited to get it, as I love the asscher cut, and have been very pleased with the Swarovski zirconias. As with all of my Swaroski zirconias, I louped it to see if the Swarovski laser inscription is on the stone. This is NOT a Swarovski stone although it has a Swarovski hang tag. Swarovski's zirconias all have the laser inscription on them. You can purchase non-Swaroski CZs for less, so I was quite disappointed. I have purchased other Swaroski zirconia pieces from the Amazon Collection with no problems.
I'm returning this necklace, and repurchasing it to see if this transaction was a fluke, and they sent the wrong item by mistake. If the new necklace contains an actual Swarovski zirconia, I will update my review. I hate false advertising. The necklace was pretty enough for two stars instead of one I normally would've given for false advertising.

title: Lacks the "Wow Factor" You See in the Photo
text:
I was hesitant to purchase this as a Christmas gift after seeing all the bad reviews about the quality and the stone coming unattached, but what I really wish others had mentioned is the actual size of this ring. While it is definitely pretty, this is not a great gift for a special lady in your life. The stone is about a quarter of the size of your pinky nail and the intricate detail you see in the picture is lost once you have this ring in person. Again, it's a very nice ring...but I'd say it's a good gift for a teen or even a child. For your wife or fiancee, this just doesn't have the wow factor that you'd expect from the picture.

So if you're buying it for a 13 year old as their first "big girl" ring, I'd say this is a 5/5 purchase for the price. For an adult, I wouldn't recommend it unless its a friendship ring or just a nice gesture. As an engagement ring or something like that though, you should look elsewhere. Don't get me wrong...it's a very nice ring...it's just not substantial.

Edit- I had to come back here and say that my wife is absolutely nuts over this ring...she wears it all the time and it looks fantastic in natural light. Although the stone didn't grow any bigger, it's a beautiful overall piece and my wife gets compliments on it often. I'd personally still rate it a 3 1/2 but my wife insists that it's a 5....and her opinion (and her friends opinions) definitely counts more than mine on a women's fashion ring.

text:
I purchased this necklace for myself. I was looking for a tiny white gold cross, and found this one with diamonds for the same price as a plain one! I'm not a person who wears jewelry usually, so I hoped that it wouldn't be too ostentatious.

The chain is very delicate, which is exactly what I was looking for, but others might be afraid that it will break. I personally plan to take it off when doing anything that might put it in a position where it might snap, such as working out, etc.

Also I was concerned about purchasing diamonds from Amazon, but I decided to take the chance for about a hundred bucks. I know that their return policy is very good should there be any problems. Well, the first one that I got, one of the diamonds was a lot darker than all the other ones in the piece. I requested an exchange from Amazon and the next one they sent me was perfect. The exchange only cost me about $2.50 more in shipping costs.

All in all, it is a very lovely petite cross with a little glitter. I also think it would make a very nice confirmation/graduation gift for a lucky teen.

title: Love these cubes!
text: I first purchased the Amazon Basic line for a trip to Europe.  I was so impressed with this cube way of packing that I purchased a set for our granddaughter, then only 10 years old.  She loved being able to organize her things in her own cubes since she often shares a suitcase with a sibling on trips.  This line is light weight.  You don't want a solid side cube because the whole idea is that it forms to your clothes so you can get more or less in each cube as well as more in your suitcase.  This Christmas her little sister, now 9, wanted her own set!  Go figure, she wanted gray, so gray it is.  As far as "wrinkle free", that's pretty hard to do because it's all in  how you fold your items in the first place.  I have not mastered a wrinkle free pack, so if you are like me, purchased a travel steamer.  Back to the cubes.  LOVE how I am kept organized and if you are planning a trip with multiple different hotel stays, organizing with cubes is AH-mazing!  If you are staying in one spot, can't tell you  how nice it is to unpack just what you need to hang up and leave the rest organized in the cubes.  Hope to "cube" all the grandchildren over time.

text:

What's great about this luggage?

Zippers - solid 3+ stars we will see how they last
Construction - solid for the price 4 stars
Expansion area - Good if not great 4 stars
Material of the hard side - good but probably not strong enough 4 stars
Rollers - amazing , a solid 5 stars, and if you love good rollers this bag will make you smile
Compartments - for the price - 4 stars maybe better.
TSA Lock - works well and they give you a tiny card you can keep in the bag which is smart.

Would I buy it again. ABSOLUTELY, but I have just taken it on one tough trip to NYC that it did fantastic on. We will see how this thing looks like in 5 years time. The lacquer on the handle button already chipped.

Good luck shopping, this one deserves consideration for that 1-3 night bag. Well done AmazonBasics! Not sure you can do better at this price point?

title: decent small weekender bag
text:
This bag fills in the niche where you need to travel light or have a short trip, and do not have any overhead space. I believe it will fit under the seat in front of you. I actually have another similar bag - both have the same carrying space, but this one is thicker (depth) whereas that bag is wider. This bag would not carry a laptop nor does it have a padded laptop section, so it's not the perfect business bag. For that I would recommend the Delsey Chatillon Trolley Tote. Maybe this is what you take for that perfect vacation where you leave the laptop at home.

It does have a nice organizing section in the front, and two side pockets that I'm not sure what you'd put in them (not for water bottles and closes flat when zipped, so maybe documents. Inside, there are several zipped sections, one of which is removable. It could be good for makeup and toiletries. Also, the bag has that strap so you can slide it on top of your larger roller bag. There's no separate shoe compartment. there is a divider (snap on) inside to make sure that your things dont' come flying out if you are getting inspected at security. However, there are no compression strpas.
Overall, it's a weekend trip sized bag. I wouldn't take it as my carry-on for daily use since I like to have a bag that's easy to throw over my shoulder and use as a large purse at my destination.

It only has two wheels, so it's not a spinner. It does have a long enough handle for a 5'8" person to carry comfortably.

I love the unusual eggplant color. Not that you'd ever check this, but if you did, it would be hard to miss on the baggage pickup.

I haven't taken this on a trip yet because it was too small for my last trip. Will update review when I do.

Amazon web page 29 x 17 x 12
Actual (my measurements) 27.5 x 17 x 11 (15% less volume than claimed)

title: Great suitcase!
text:
We put this little suitcase through its paces on a trip to Eastern Europe. It was dragged up and down cobble stone streets, over tram tracks, up and down curbs and off and on public transportation! We were shocked at how well ours held up (hubby got the navy blue).
The telescopic handle is very wobbly and we were a little concerned about how well it would work but they have held strong. The wheels seem to be doing great too! It's easy to maneuver, rolls very smoothly and you can actually fit a lot of things in it. We checked our bags on the flight and it helped having the expandable 2 inches to accommodate gifts/souveniers we were bringing back. There are a few scratches on the outside of the case from the flight/baggage claim, but that is to be expected when they throw your stuff around!
We would definitely recommend!

title: pretty!
text: For the price you can't beat this necklace. I am used to something a little weightier and only wear sterling which this is supposed to be, but it feels hollow and less substantial than my other sterling necklaces. For the money I am not complaining . It is not as skimpy as the Dogeared version and has more substance than that one but no heft. Feels hollow on the inside and is stamped "China" in a discreet place inside one shank of the wishbone..wished it was Italy or Mexico as the snob in me wasn't crazy about that, but it is very lovely and shiny and hangs well on the chain. It wasn't tangled at all - in fact I really like the chain and though I usually wear a 16" as longer chains tend to look sloppy on me, in this case I think the 18" drop shows off the wishbone best and looks so classy on. Also the chain appears to be fairly well made, not as flimsy as I expected in reading the reviews. It is everything I like in a necklace - minimal but eyecatching and classy and certainly looks like it cost more. Good gift for a girl or woman of any age, and I think it would make a lovely bridesmaid or holiday gift! You can always change out the chain to customize the length, and I will even try to pair it with a skinny leather cord, changing it up a little more. It looks absolutely lovely the way it drapes when worn. Uncommonly good for the price.

title: Great catch all / light hiking backpack / or extra diaper bag
text:
This bag feels like a raincoat and “blue tarp” had a baby. The material appears as if it is waterproof (ish), I haven’t used it in wet weather to say for 100% if it would keep everything completely dry. The mesh back is not open to the interior. I would assume that this is more of a protective thing, if you were wearing this bag directly on your skin it would either stick to you or you would develop sores from the material rubbing, I believe the fabric mesh would stop that.
Lots of pockets and storage spots in the bag, can fit a lot of items in this. The shoulder straps are VERY comfortable. You could use this as a light weight book bag and be very comfortable in it. As packaged without adjusting straps bag went on easy, resting below my waist line, sitting on my butt. I am 5’9”, still have a lot of room to extend straps for larger or smaller size. There is not a mid-chest strap that clips / fastens in the front. While you can wear this in front of you, it will ride low.

One thing that COULD BE an issue is the bottom of the bag. This is the area that (for me) tends to break down the most quickly. Of course, this is the area of any bag that takes the most abuse and usually wears out first. From my experience it is because of either the material or stitching being the same as the rest of the bag. This bag has that issue to some degree. The material does appear to be slightly thicker, yet the same type, but the stitching is exactly the same. Not a deal breaker on the bag just a FYI.

One additional issue, the zipper on this bag is not smooth to open. Mine caught easily several time. It did not rip the bag just more of an annoyance. 4 stars because of base and zipper issues

title: This is No Basic Bag!
text:
This AmazonBasics under-seat carry-on case is anything but basic. It measures 13X13X9" and is engineered to be surprisingly roomy. The telescoping handle can be set to three different lengths so it's comfortable whether you're a kid or average height, or tall. There's a passthrough, and the case will strap to larger luggage without drooping. The wheels are smooth and spin well.

There are zippered compartments on either side of the bag that will fit paperbacks or tablets, or phones, and one on the front with slots tickets and passports. The main zipper - the one that opens the bag - is designed so that you can slip things in and out of it in the airplane without any hassle. I was able to slip my 13" MacBook Pro in and pull it out without any problem.

Inside, there's a toiletry holder that you can detach and hang up. It has four zippered compartments in sizes that will hold shampoo or small items like pills and makeup.

This bag is beautifully designed and seems far more expensive than it is. It's surprisingly heavy, but that's due to great construction and solid wheels.

They are nice and dark and they're also comfortable with arms that don't pinch or bind or irritate the tops of my ears. The frames and lenses have an expensive look and feel to them that I like - but most importantly, they're very good at protecting my sensitive eyes from the sun. title: Nice waterproof light bag. (4.5 stars)
text:
Bag is nice...Feels a little cheap when empty, but that's because of the light weight materials used, but lightweight is key for use of hiking, etc when you want a bag as light as possible . Once loaded, at no point did it feel cheap! The handle felt secure, the zippers felt secure, and everything felt "in place".

The exterior has a nice mesh pouch for a water bottle (shown here with my 32oz bottle) and elastic cord weave for securing quick access items (show with rain jacket) or wet/dirty items you don't want inside your bag.

First compartment has a very deep channel that goes down and under the bag, deceivingly large. It also has two elastic mesh pockets and a zippered pouch behind (the size of the two mesh pockets), great for stuffing sunglasses, flashlights, tools, phones, etc.

Main compartment has an open pouch, about half the size of the bag. Good to keep items you don't want to fall to the bottom like snacks or tool or electronics. The main compartment is a decent size (30L) large enough to fit a large laptop, even though there is no padding for one. I stuffed size 12 sneakers, a hoodie, tshirt and full medical kit with enough room for a few more items.

Now for the nit-pic of what I would like to see... I wish the main compartment pocket was padded for items I need protection for (cell phone, tablet, binoculars, etc.). title: 10K Swarvorski 2ct vs Platinum Plated Sterling 2ct Cubic Zirconia
text:
I originally purchased the 10k Swarvorski Crystal 2ct solitaire pendant also by Amazon Curated Collection to replace my real 2ct pendant when I go on water vacation/pools which is not good for any real jewels. I loved that it was Swarvorski crystal BUT the setting was extremely dainty and fragile making it look very cheap. Probably due to the fact that it was a 10k gold setting so they were skimpy in the quality of the item. Also, that item would never lay flat on your neck. The solitaire was drooping downwards. Very bad design.
Now onto this actual item which is also 2ct BUT Cubic Zirconia which is no where as nice as Swarvorski Crystal. The upside of this item is that the basket setting of the solitaire looks exactly like my real diamond pendant. Heftier and doesn't droop forward like the other one. And another thing is that if you want to change the chain for this platinum plates sterling, you will need cut the chain off because it does NOT allow you to simply slide the solitaire off.
In the end, this will work for the days I'm in the pool or the beach but I doubt the cubic zirconia will hold up without clouding/dulling if worn everyday.
Now if Amazon would put a Swarvorski in this setting, it would be IDEAL!

title: Very durable bag!
text:
I’ve used this bag since September 2017 (23 months) as my primary travel bag. It’s flown 200+ flight segments during that time, nearly 50% of those flights either gate checked or as a checked bag. Last week, the telescoping handle began to stick. When I purchased this bag, I never imagined it would last nearly 2 years as I paid under $50 for it.

Pros:
- extremely durable
- bright color (sky blue) makes it easy to find
- long handle makes pulling through an airport easy
- zipper extension makes the case have extra room if needed

Cons:
- does not fit into overhead bins of small regional jets
- bumper stickers do not adhere well

I will likely repurchase this, or another amazon basics suitcase when my Samsonite carry-on wears out.

title: WAY smaller than advertised!
text:
I bought the "21-inch" model of this suitcase, which is supposedly 22" x 14.9" x 10" (see the product images). There's a note that the height they're claiming (22") is counting the wheels and top handle, but even allowing for that, the actual item is not even close to these measurements, in any dimension.

With the wheels it's barely 20" tall, with MAYBE 18" of actual compartment height. It's almost 9" deep (not 10"), and not even 12" wide (no idea how they're claiming 14.9" here).

I can't comment on how well the suitcase works or how it holds up, because as soon as I pulled it out of the box, I chuckled and began my return. I did take the time to measure it, to prove to myself I wasn't crazy. See the pictures I've provided to get more of a sense of the ACTUAL product dimensions.

If you're looking for a very compact, hard-sided carry-on, I'm sure this one is fine, but I can't tolerate the blatant false advertising and feel compelled to inform other potential buyers of this scam.

title: Four years now, thrown around the world
text:
I had to come leave a review for this little suitcase. I almost didn't buy it because at the time I hadn't seen much of the Amazon Basics brand that was showing up on different products. Needing something reliable and sturdy, I was ready to spend more money for brands that were better-known and trusted for luggage. I'm really glad I didn't spend the extra money. We now have multiples of these in different colors. It helps a lot when picking up checked baggage because these brighter colors stand out. I love the wheels, you can push it in front of you, pull it behind, or glide it at your side. There's been times I was leaning in on it, tired from a flight, and glided like a breeze. There is also a handle on the side that makes it easy to grab, lift, and toss from that way, too. The expansion zipper on the side gives even more room when you have more packed than you expected.

The bottom line really is that these suitcases have just kept going for us. My kids have slid them down our stairs instead of carrying them down, they've been tossed into our vehicles and fallen out to the pavement when the tailgate opens. Most of all, they've been thrown all over the world by airlines (and us) and still work and function great. No cracking, no visible scratching, no fading, no broken zippers, wheels, or handles. The interior lining, zippers, and straps have stayed strong. They nest great, too, so if you know you're going to be coming home with gifts and a lot more stuff than you're leaving with, pack your little one and put it in a bigger one and go. You'll have two separate suitcases to fill on the way home. Likewise if you're packed heavy with things on your way, pack two and when you come home put the smaller one in the bigger one and check one bag.

They seem to be reasonably durable, but the zippers feel a little cheap and I just have a feeling that overfilling would cause the zipper to fail. I would not use the expansion zipper; they just don't feel like they can take that much stuff in them.

The wheels roll OK, not great and not badly. I'm 6' tall and the handle is just a little short for me, but that's pretty much normal compared to other bags I've had and this one is far from the worst in that regard.

Colors are pretty cool and the plastic held up to daily loading in and out of my car, often with stuff piled on top.

I would recommend these for a light trip on a plane or for traveling in a car, but I don't think I would pack them heavy for a plane ride.

text:
I have had a Gustin canvas and leather duffle bag, but as I get older I get more jealous of people wheeling through the airport with their hardshell suitcases. I was orginally looking at the Away products, but at 250 bucks a pop I couldn't justify it. Enter the amazon basics suitcase!

The Amazon Basics Hardside Spinner can easily fit clothes for a 5-7 day trip depending on where you're going, with room for expansion with the zipper system. I was able to fit 6 t-shirts, a button up, a cardigan, a set of pajamas, underwear and socks for 5 days, a pair of jeans, my laptop and charger, plus a pair of size 12 vans, all with room to spare!

It also has 4 different zipper compartments for storing your smaller items and delicates/dirty clothes, tie down straps, well attached handles, and comes in my favorite shade of Kinda Funny blue. Looking forward to getting many trips with this little guy, and I think the girlfriend will be ordering one for herself soon.

title: Elegant Space for a Small Collection
text:
This jewelry box is the perfect way to keep a small collection of jewelry in one place and in good shape, without allowing pieces to scratch each other or become tangled. I have had my silver and gold jewelry in this box for approximately two weeks, and the silver has not tarnished.
The wood veneer is a pretty dark red, and the neutral gray interior of the box will match any bedroom or boudoir. Note that there is only a single extra-small compartment suitable for rings, so ring enthusiasts may want to choose a different design.
There was a significant chemical smell - it reminded me of superglue - that wafted from the box when I first opened it, but with time the smell seems to be dissipating. Still, a collector with a sensitive nose might want to air the box out before using it.

title: Great bag, excellent functionally.
text:
Really quite glad I finally purchased a personal item luggage bag. It's a fantastic way to utilize all of the free space when you travel.
Pros: the bag is very lightweight and has ample cargo room considering its size and intention. I was able to pack clothes for 3 days only taking up about 60% of the space. There is a telescoping handle making it easy to carry through a busy airport. The interior of the bag includes a removable tolitries compartment which I find handy. In addition there are 3 external pockets: two side pockets that are long but wont fit much, maybe a charger and some clean socks. There is also a front pocket with card holders perfect for storing your cellphone, ID and boarding pass. The one real bonus that this bag has that I wasnt able to find with cheaper options is a strap horizontally across the back which allows you to rest your personal item bag on top of a carry on bag by inserting the telescoping handle of the larger bag through the strap.
Cons: I would prefer a hard case bag to keep my belongings safer and I would also have preferred to have 360 wheels. Aside from that, it's a fantastic bag and I look forward to using it.

title: Can be difficult to thread into your ear!
text: The design of these earrings apparently has changed from the featured picture since the original positive reviews from 2011. While the basic style appears the same (and is pretty good, IMO), the post (part that goes through the ear) on the pair I received is not the generic teeny-tiny cylinder you would expect (in the picture it looks like the typical thing you would see on any generic stud). Instead, it's actually almost a wedge - flat and angular as opposed to being rounded; starts out wide at the hinge and gets somewhat narrower as you approach the opposite end where you would snap the clasp. The wedge is about 2-3mm thick - for your usual lobe piercings this is big. My girlfriend could not thread the earrings in at all and she was very disappointed b/c she loved the diamond cut. I'll have to return these.

text:
Edit to Update: it’s been a couple of years now and this bag is still performing excellently. It’s been to Canada, Florida twice, and France. Absolutely love how sturdy this bag is and how much can fit in it.

Original review: Just used this bag for a 5-day trip. I traveled on Spirit Airlines - this bag qualifies as a free personal carry-on. I packed 3 shorts, 3 shirts, a dress, 2 pair of sandals, 2 swim suits, undergarments, 3 pair of socks, PJ’s, a small amount of make-up and a few toiletries (little to no liquids), charging cables for my phone, watch, headphones, a portable battery, and a large 30 oz stainless steel Tervis cup. I could have probably managed to put a few more things in the outside pockets but I didn’t need anything else. I was concerned that the zipper was going to bust but the zipper worked perfectly! I folded my clothes on the way there and rolled them on the way back. By rolling my stuff, I was able to fit the souvenir shirts and trinkets I bought on my trip in addition to everything above. Excellent purchase!! I plan to buy two more for family members.

text:
We bought this umbrella for a trip to Copenhagen in late fall. We chose it based on the reviews. I've bought a lot of AmazonBasics products, and have had overwhelmingly positive experiences...until this product.

In addition to this purchase we also brought along a second cheap umbrella we were given FOR FREE at Nordstrom Rack (it's nothing nice - it literally says "Nordstrom Rack" on the umberella's shade/canopy). Long story short, we preferred the cheap Nordstrom Rack umbrella.

After a week in Copenhagen, and using this umbrella around 5 times, it was barely staying together. One of the metal umbrella arms (beneath the canopy) had broken in normal usage, and the umbrella was wobbly and loose in it's joints, from handle to extension to canopy. Overall a very disappointing purchase that I won't recommend or repeat.

title: One of the better pieces from the Amazon Curated Collection
text:
I had just about given up on the Amazon Curated Collection. I purchased and received at least three poorly designed pieces that were overpriced and had looked like they had been spray painted by a kindergartner and then had glitter or fake stones thrown on for a final touch. Perhaps because this lacks sparkly things, this piece is more passable than others in the Amazon Curated Collection. I ordered this in silver and the color is uniform. The size is not too quaint. It is a piece that is unique and,for the most part, attracts positive attention.

The attention that it draws can lead to the two flaws. The first is that the word "China" is stamped on the inside of the charm. The word is not tiny. It spans nearly one whole side of the charm, so if you are at the right angle and have good eyesight, this stamp is very visible.

The second quibble, and this could be just a personal preference,is the size of the hole through which the chain passes. It is much bigger than it needs to be when compared to the overall size of the charm. From the front, the top of the wish bone seems small, but from the side, the hole extends much farther than it needs do and makes it look a little cheap, especially if it is also the side from which the word China is visible.

The chain is fine; It is light and does not take attention away from the charm.

All in all, I like the necklace. I wish the country of origin stamp had been on a part of the necklace that would be against the chest. The design could have been more attractive with a loop that was smaller and more appropriate for the overall size of the wishbone charm. It is a simple piece that would fit in with many outfits and would work for women of many ages.

I would recommend it.

The mount of the main CZ stone is fairly open at the back and sides to let light in, so in the right light it sparkles from within. ("Asher cut" is apparently an alternate spelling of Asscher cut.) The ten smaller CZs in each hoop also sparkle nicely.

The cultured pearls on mine aren't quite the same size, but unless they're next to each other it's hard to tell.

The clasp for the hinged post is a U-shape with bumps at the top to keep the post in place, seems reliable.

The jewelry marks are 925 for the sterling silver (92.5% silver), CHINA, and what looks like an 8 in a circle--not sure what that is.

The earrings come in a black paper box with a faux-velour-lined platform inside. Mine weren't attached to the platform but there are slits to hold them. (The platform is reversible--the bottom is padded with a slit to hold a ring.) One of the earrings comes with a Swarovski Zirconia tag attached with a thread.

title: Perfect carry-on for a senior traveler.
text: I bought the smaller carry-on because, as I am now in my mid-70s, I have a difficult time lifting the larger ones into overhead compartments. Also I travel on small regional airplanes that have much smaller overhead bins. This carry-on was ideal. Not only did it fit perfectly into the much smaller overhead bins, but it meant that I wasn’t taking up a huge amount of space on the larger airplane bins either. I was able to easily maneuver it down the isles, even using a cane, and stored it with ease. Much to my surprise, it held a surprisingly large amount of clothing. An added bonus is that it usually fits underneath the seat of the wheelchairs now in use in larger airports. It is an ideal carry-on for someone with the travel requirements that come with more crowded flights, more pushy people with oversized carry-on bags that hog the overhead space, and the need to take up less personal space when traveling. I am thrilled with this product.

title: Very Impressed
text:
I'm very impressed with this medium sized Amazon-branded suitcase. The quality level of the materials and construction is very good and on par with major name brand luggage. The bag is not ultralight, but has a nice solid feel and isn't overly heavy either. The bag very attractive in purple (which is a distinct shade that will stand out on a baggage carousel), and it is very thoughtfully designed. Features included:
+very smooth rolling and smooth turning wheels
+handles on three sides of the bag for flexible carry options
+plastic skid plates on one side for setting it down horizontally
+permanent pull-out name tag holder
+very sturdy telescoping handle with two locking height positions
+combination lock for use with the main compartment zippers
+expandable zippered section that increases internal storage depth by several inches
+externally accessible storage section for easy-access
+plenty of zippered internal storage sections for dividing belongings
+handy removable zippered storage bag (useful for wet items, dirty clothes, etc)
Overall, I haven't found anything I don't like about this piece. I will update my review down the road if I run into any issues with durability, but otherwise this bag is great: handsome looks, good quality, and great functionality all around.

title: Gorgeous Studs
text: These earrings are great!  They have sparkle and really cut up in the light.  Not as much fire as the real thing, but they are very close.  The prong setting looks like white gold or platinum.  Unless you hang out with jewelers or someone with a trained eye, or you tell someone, no one will know these are fakes.  These studs are very appropriate for everyday use.  Each individual stone is exactly 6mm in lengh and width, which is just a hair under 1/4 quarter of an inch.  Each individual stud looks to be about one carat.  They don't feel heavy on my ear.  They are a believeable size and can pass for the real thing.  If I had gotten a 5mm stud, as I had originally planned, I would have been very unhappy with the smaller size.  The backings are snug and secure. I may buy a disk backing just to make the stud stand up a little more.  But, if I don't, the earrings will still look good.  I have slightly larger genuine stones reserved for special occasions, so if I lose one of these during everyday use, I won't be heartbroken.  P.S.:  I had a bad experience with the U.S. Post Office delivering these, but Amazon stepped in and took care of the problem promptly and courteously.
