title: Sterling silver coating is bad, not good for sensitive ears
text:
Be aware... sterling silver does not mean that the item itself is real silver- just that it's been coated.

I do not believe the posts have been coated, because they are turning black and hurting my ear. I have a nickel allergy and cannot wear cheap jewelry because it tarnishes and creates painful inflammation. I am currently letting my ears 'rest' for a few days and ordering something more expensive to ensure it is actually hypoallergenic.

The listing indicates that the entire earring is sterling silver coated (post and stud), but the post is definitely not OR the coating is so thin that it doesn't last. I would have been better off applying the cost of these earrings to a pair of better quality.

title: Good packing cubes, narrow (slim) size isn't as useful
text: These are pretty standard packing cubes - sturdy cloth with a zipper. I've been trying to make "packs" of gym clothes and office clothes so that I can grab them and go throughout the week (clothes prep, like meal prep), and the small and medium bag are really useful for a single outfit. The large size is good for packing for long trips - it's a bit too large to separate clothes for a carry on, but could be good if you're just looking to have all your clothes in one bag. The reason I give this 4 stars is the "slim" bag - it just isn't useful. It's too long to be practical for socks/underwear, and too narrow for anything else. title: Made In America!
text:
Blue sapphires are one of my favorite stones to wear and these are subtle and designed well. The checkerboard cut makes them sparkle and catch the light more than many other cuts and the minimal, silver basket settings allow maximum light to shine through. Their dark blue created stones are clear and without inclusions.

The secure, lever back findings work smoothly and have plain, stamped ear wires. Though mine had no sharp edges, I wish that they were a bit more finished. I can see the rougher metal edge on the front when I look closely, though it doesn't show from a distance. If it were smoother and shiner, I would rate these 5 stars.

I enjoy wearing these pretty, created sapphire earrings and I'm extremely happy that they are made in America!

Update- I've these for a year and a half or more now and they are still in good shape. I noticed that the silver had tarnished a bit the last time I was going to wear them, turning a goldish brown on the surface. I cleaned them easily by dunking them in Goddard's silver dip [[ASIN:B0063KBKZU Goddard's Silver Care Liquid Dip - 10 oz.]] and they look like new! I love the stuff!

title: A Beautiful Asscher Cut Swarovski Pendant!
text:
Having had the matching earrings for almost four months now, I recently picked up this necklace on a lightning deal and absolutely love the set! I've included a picture to show them together. It doesn't do them justice, as they shine and sparkle amazingly, but it's really difficult to get a photo that shows that without so much glare that you can't see the pieces.

To me, it looks like all the stones are the same size, about 5/16 inch or 7.5 mm. I think the pendant appears a bit larger but don't believe it actually is. . . could be the extending bale that makes it appear larger. I've had 3 carat cubic zirconia earrings in a different "square" cut that were so large that I sent them back. The Asscher cut is a "thicker" stone so it doesn't appear as large. It gives great depth and sparkle to the stones though and I love the shape as well. The platinum plated setting is extra shiny and elegant looking.

The included chain is dainty and 18 inches long with two round links to wear it at 16 and 17 inches if desired. Mine arrived slightly tangled but they were carefully and easily removed. It fastens with a spring-ring clasp.

I have quite a few pieces of cubic zirconia jewelry and have never had any of them dull or loose their shine. Some of the cheaper plated settings may change but the stones remain shiny and clear. I take care of them and clean them carefully per instructions. My Swarovski Zirconias are even more consistently manufactured, cut, and beautiful!

I trust that I will enjoy wearing this set for many, many years. Recommend!

title: Lovely!
text:
These earrings are quite lovely for a fancy evening. They aren't too heavy (sometimes dangly earrings start to feel like bowling balls after an hour or so!), and catch the light quite nicely. Though these are crystal and pearl, the pearls especially are of a nice quality. The crystal catches the light nicely, but a close inspection reveals them to not be diamond chips - so there is a level of fanciness that these are appropriate for, and a level in which they are not quite fancy enough... So, you may not wear them as frequently as other, more versatile earrings as these really can't be "dressed down" without looking ridiculous!

I think the price fits in with the mid-range of the fancy-levels of places that you can wear these. I wouldn't wear them during the day, but they are great for sprucing up a nice night out on the town!

title: Perfect fit for my carry on bags - can pack 7 days worth of clothing easily!
text: I already own the 4 piece packing cube set in medium, and the 3 pack slim size, and love packing cubes. I noticed that with the medium set, I had a hard time fitting the full cubes into my carry on bag (which is a large backpack or a sturdy travel duffel), so I wanted to try a smaller size cube to fit my carry ons better. These ended up being the perfect size for me, I can fit a full weeks worth of clothes in them and easily pack them in my bags. On a recent trip I had one with tops, one with bottoms, one with my undergarments/socks/pajamas/swimwear, and the fourth one was where I kept my raincoat, windbreaker, hat/scarf and a thick sweatshirt. I was amazed that all that outerwear fit into one bag! I am a petite lady, but I was still pleasantly surprised. I gave the medium cubes away to my mom and now use the small ones exclusively!

title: Excellent product and value for the price - highly recommended
text: Excellent packing cubes, especially for the price!  Highly recommended.  I have been using packing cubes since before most people knew what packing cubes were.  Yes, I just dated myself.  I just came back from a trip to Mexico, and while I do have the vacuum, or "space" type bags and have recently used them with great success, I elected to go with the packing cubes this time.  I was able to pack a large amount of clothes in the medium, small and narrow sizes.  5 days of swimming, activities, and fancy dinners (all-inclusive resort), including shoes, hat, jacket, dresses, the works.  This set is an amazing value for the price.  The material is lightweight and the mesh helps to keep air flowing through (a must in humid climates).  The zippers are high quality and work very smoothly.  The handles are convenient for when you stuff the cubes in a carry-on sized bag.  Overall, an outstanding value.  Thanks Amazon for continuing to expand the AmazonBasics line with some more great selections.

text: I'm a convert to packing cubes.  I travel a lot, and these cubes are just what I needed.  When packing, I spread out everything on the bed that I'm going to take on the trip.  Then I pack like with like.  Socks and undies, for example in the long skinny bag.  Shirts in one rectangle.  Trousers in another.  Jackets in the big bag.  Then when I get to my destination, I put the first three cubes into a drawer, and hang the jackets.  Hey, presto, everything's unpacked, and I know where everything is.  Love them. title: Organizing the chaos of family travel
text: We bought 3 different colored sets of these to keep individual family member’s clothing separate while traveling. It’s helped keep the chaos of one big suitcase organized on weeklong or weekend trips and it’s much easier to find what we need! We don’t use every size for every trip but the variety of sizes allows for the ability to pack varying amounts of clothing for different trips as well as keeping other supplies (like diapers or baby monitors and pack n play sheets!) organized as well. We roll up our shirts and pants and put socks and underwear on top or in their own bag. These are thin (lightweight!) and definitely more cost-effective than many name brands but the zippers are strong and the fabric feels solid and sturdy. We love the bright colors (we got navy, light blue and green - easy to find!) and I can see them lasting for many years!

title: Rhodium Plated
text: I understand why there is a hype about rhodium plated "everything" as it looks similar to platinum at a fraction of the cost. Unfortunately, I personally don't like the darker tint of the rhodium plating so I won't be covering the necklace again once the plating gets worn out. I have had silver jewelry and I wear it on a daily basis so I don't have to worry about it tarnishing. The necklace itself is behaving quite nicely, the only thing that worries me is the ring that connects the clasp with the necklace - it seems quite thin to me, especially with the thickness of the necklace. I have a bracelet of the same Figaro Link with the exact same width and thickness and the ring on that is much larger and looks much sturdier than what is on the necklace. Necklace came in a plain box, wasn't padded or anything, just left to move freely in the jewelry box which slightly surprised me. Overall, I'm quite happy with my purchase and would definitely recommend it for someone looking for a rhodium plated necklace.

He says his favorite feature is the stitch details that go all around the top of the soles, and he says that they enhance the beauty of the shoes. title: Good addition to fill Gaps if you have some other sizes. Handy for Miata - MX5!
text: These are good and stretch well.  I intended to buy Medium (instead of small), but these serve a great niche purpose. I do have some others cubes from a different manufacturer that are 4" high instead of 3" high.  The other versions allow you to pack about 5-7 days of an item in a single cub.e  With an inch less, these  will hold about 2 complete summer outfits if like to pack your outfits by day.  One of these can hold about  2 sets of Shorts, 2 Underwear, 2T-Shirt/Polo, and 2 pairs Socks)  Or, if you want to fill it with all of the same things, it will hold aobut 4 pairs of mens cargo shorts.... or 5-7  short sleeve t-shirts or polos.  You might be able to get two pairs of Jeans in there, but I'd recommend a different size for those.  These are perfectly fine for filling in gaps in larger suit cases, and one set of the small cubes (4 pieces)  is probably good for a pair of travelers.  If you want more,  grab a pair of mediums.  The extra-small variant is  also good for bra's, belts, socks and boxers.  Another note,  we have a Mazda Miata MX-5 Converitble and the trunk is TINY!  We've moved away from bringing suitcases and just fill the trunk with a bunch of various size cubes when we take 5-7 day road trips.  They are like mini breathable suitcases.  And, if you fold well  (even your dirty laundry because you have to make it back),  two people can easily carry about 7-10 days worth of clothes with multiple changes in the back of a Miata!

It was handled and tossed about by many different baggage handlers incl. those from Amtrak, Rocky Mountaineer, taxi drivers, tour coach drivers and hotel bell staff.  No problems at all.  This sturdy,  slightly expandable suitcase is very spacious and rolls with ease.  There are also grab handles on three sides, making it easier for baggage handlers.  Note that a lock must be purchased separately.  For me, this was a great buy and was exactly what I needed.  I highly recommend this item for your travels.

title: O.K.
text:
It's of an adequate quality. I mean for a cheap price, you get three different lengths, so I wasn't expecting anything amazing.

But the packaging was SO frustrating. I was going to give this as an xmas gift.
The box it came in was covered in barcode stickers inside and out. When I tried to take it off, it ripped the outer layer of the box. The two circle tapes that held the box close ripped the outer layer too. The padding inside is like... meshy, hole-y, rough material that kept getting caught in the links. (When this happens, don't pull on it, even though it takes a long time to take out- with the quality of the chain, it'll probably break off)

Now, this is the part that made me most annoyed. The three chains were in a small black velvet bag with strings that are too thick for the bag that it doesn't properly pull to close. But that wasn't it. So it's in a bag, on the padding, in the box. All three chains. Together.

When I took them out, they were so badly tangled it took me 20-30 min to untangle them before I could wrap it.
That was really annoying... especially because I just cut my nails, so I had such a hard time untangling them.

Annoying, but cheap. Cheap but adequate. For me, it was worth it, I guess, because I had to buy TONS of gifts this year.

title: Small, but beautiful (my mother loves it)
text:
I purchased this necklace along with the earrings as a gift for my mom for Mother's day. True, I was surprised by the size, but it all worked out in the end because my mother loves small jewelry. To be perfectly honest, I was afraid it would be too big. My mother greatly dislikes heavy necklaces and earring as she finds them distracting. The butterfly on both the necklace and the earrings is the same size - ruffly the size of a dime.

This set had well-cut medium to light stones with no visible occlusions. The metal work seems sturdy for its size, and the chain seems rather delicate. I may look into a new chain, as I am not truly confident in the one shipped.

AS A SIDE NOTE: It is a VERY good idea to purchase a separate chain when buying a piece over the internet, in person if you can. The same applies to having spare earing backs in the appropriate metal, which can be purchased through jewelry supple sites (every woman should have some spares on hand!). if there are nics or dull spots and you are not comfortable polishing the metal yourself (this can be an affect of the casting process) most jewelers will be more then happy to do it for you for a small fee... just make sure to accompany
any polishing that is done to very valuable pieces!

NOT TO SELLERS/AMAZON: Please, please, PLEASE include dimensions. Even better, place a recognizable object (currency works well) next to the piece that is of relative size so that the buyer has a very clear idea of what they are buying. They will thank you for it by having more confidence in the size of the piece, thus making your goods more attractive!

They do fit a lot more than what you think these type fits 2 bras, 7 panties, and 7 pairs of socks in one cube. I bring a compression bag for the dirty stuff and that is at the bottom, clean on top, one cube.

title: Good, everyday necklace, still beautiful 3 years later!
text:
I've been looking for a good, everyday necklace that I can just leave on all the time and I think this is it.

The chain is way too short, but that's nothing a few inch long extender can't fix.

The actual pendant is small without being too small, and a good weight ‐ I'm not worried about it bending or snapping, and it's heavy enough to pull down properly on the chain when worn.

I think if the pendant were bigger, it'd be too obvious & gawdy.

Overall, on first day wearing it, so far so good

UPDATE 3 YEARS LATER: After non-stop daily wear for almost 3 years, it's still shiny silver, sturdy, scratch-free, and subtly pretty as ever. I've gone through maybe 4 different chains that broke over the years but the pendant is still looking like I just bought it yesterday. It looks a bit gold in my photo lightening but in real life it's definitely all silver colored without a hint of yellow.

title: Dainty, but workmanship defect
text: I found these at a great price and thought they would make great gifts to have on hand.  I purchased 2 sets.  The french hooks are a bit thin and do seem to bend easily, but that would not prevent me from purchasing them had I seen them beforehand.  They are simple, but striking - sure to get compliments.  One pair was perfect, and the person who received them for a gift, loved them.  With the second pair, one earring appeared tangled out of the bag.  Upon further inspection, it is not actually tangled, but the bottom circle is attached to the intended circle as well as a circle higher up on the earring.  There is no way to untangle it, but one solution would be to clip off the bottom circles from both earrings, making them a bit shorter.  Not sure yet if I will return it or alter the earring.  Anyway, just thought I'd share this little tidbit for anyone interested in purchasing.

title: Used while traveling throughout Europe
text: I went on a trip to Europe recently - 5 cities in 10 days - and I decided to purchase some extra packing cubes to help me organize my clothes. Since we were going to be traveling by train and some small planes, I had to pack everything in a carry-on! I already had a set of packing cubes that included one small cube, so I bought these 4 additional smalls and used one cube for each city. It worked out brilliantly! Since we were constantly on the move, sometimes spending only a day or two in one place, I wanted to avoid having to unpack and repack my suitcase every time we traveled to the next destination. Instead of having to dig through my entire suitcase, I would only have to pull out one cube at a time. I numbered the cubes to make them easily identifiable and it made getting dressed and getting my bag reorganized for the next leg of our trip so easy! I will never pack another way again.

title: Doesn't roll properly
text:
I had purchased this suitcase for 3 reasons. Colour (I went orange), weight (needed to carry back as much chocolate as possible) and maneuverability (needed to navigate busy streets and train stations).

Colour: I recognized it the minute it came off the conveyor belt. 5 stars

Weight: I brought back a 13" touchscreen monitor, and lots of Lion Bars and Choccy hobnobs. The lightweight of the bag kept me under the 50lb weight limit 5 stars

Maneuverability: I needed something i could pull by my side through the busy streets and tube stations of London as I needed to change hotels and catch trains during rush hour. I needed it to move sideways on 4 wheels. Unfortunately, even unladen, the wheels automatically turn so that the suitcase would move in a forward or backward fashion and not sideways. When in that configuration I would either kick the suitcase, or if I had it out to the side my hand would hurt. The only way to comfortably move it was on 2 wheels like a 2 wheeled suitcase. I have a 2 wheeler that works, but wanted a 4 wheeler for better maneuverability. This suitcase failed miserably at that. 1 star.

title: The Amazon Experience
text:
Firstly, for those who wish to purchase this item. By all means do so. My bad rating is based on my overall experience with the purchase.

I order this ring along with two other items on 26th November 2012. All of which qualified for free shipping and I chose the option to bundle my items. So I place my order and all was well. A couple days later I was notified that only two items were shipped and the ring will be shipping soon. So they were no longer bundled. The first two items were shipping using Lasership and arrived by the 30th November. The ring was shipped on the 29th November and arrived yesterday 17th December 2012 using USPS. The delivery estimate was 4th December 2012.

Knowing the issues customers sometimes encounter with this shipping provider (USPS) why wasn't the same shipping provider (Lasership) used?

Amazon, when someone bundles their packages, they do so for a reason. I think that you should at least ask the customer before you just split their order. You should ask which package is of more priority when you need to split the shipment.

Once more, I am disappointed with your business processes and decisions.

title: Certainly very sparkly!
text:
I was initially hesitant about purchasing such a high-value pair of earrings sight unseen but I am glad I took the plunge. I had scoured local shops and visited many websites but chose Amazon based on previous positive purchasing experiences and the high number of positive ratings for the product. I ended up purchasing the 0.75cttw in white gold for $730. I watched the product for a while as prices fluctuate so am very happy with the deal I got. Having previously (and devastatingly) lost one of my 1cttw diamond studs that had a push post back, I was specifically looking for one with screw backs as I hope these will be more 'loss proof'. I did find it a bit fiddly to put on, however, I am more than happy to cope with a bit of fiddliness given how secure they feel. I will be wearing these for everyday wear a will not be taking them off very often.

They arrived in a very lovely presentation box, the navy colour making the diamonds sparkle even more prominent. If they were a gift they would certainly be very impressive being presented in this box.

I have no regrets on this purchase, the earrings are just lovely. They are very clear and sparkly which was my greatest concern purchasing sight unseen. I cannot see any obvious inclusions and they are certainly not cloudy which was my biggest fear. Although only being a 'good' in terms of cut, they are still incredibly sparkly and impressive. I am actually incredibly surprised with the quality of this product given the price. I did note however that although the product description said that the diamonds were a minimum weight of 0.75cttw, the IGI certification states they are only 0.71cttw. I contacted customer service and they were incredibly quick to offer a discount to address the discrepancy in what I ordered compared to what was advertised. I cannot fault the customer service from Amazon, it was amazing. So despite being a bit smaller than I thought I was ordering, I absolutely love them and would certainly recommend this product.

title: These Packing Cubes are Essential if Want to Stay Organized While Travelling
text:
My international travelling began 2 years and 8 months ago, and these packing cubes are still holding strong! I knew I'd be living out of my backpack constantly packing and repacking so staying organized and efficient was a major concern. I searched around the internet desperate to find the "perfect" set but eventually came across these guys on amazon. I took the leap and bought them and have loved them ever since! These cubes are my favorite part of packing and here's why:

PROS:
1.) Everything has its place.
2.) Items are easier to locate or remove.
3.) The design gives you freedom to fit more with less mess and durability.
4.) Packing is ridiculously easy and fast.

CONS:
None. Investing in these cubes were game-changing!

So, if you travel, do yourself a favor and buy these packing cubes. I have used them for nearly 3 years and will continue to do so until they get worn out, which doesn't seem to be any time soon. They're durable, efficient, and will save you lots of time because your clothes will ALWAYS be organized and easy to locate without disrupting everything else in your desired bag of transportation. Enjoy!

title: Great quality for the price
text:
Compact, sturdy, and a real bargain at the price. The materials feel higher quality than I would have expected for $12. The press-to-close function lets you stay covered even as you duck into a car. Depending on how you grip the umbrella, you may accidentally trigger the close action, but so far this has only happened to me once.

If I could change one thing, I would ask for a 'medium' sized variant with a diameter around 48 inches, as opposed to this model's 37 inches. When the rain comes down at an angle, taller users may find their legs getting drenched. I won't knock off a star for the size, as it was pretty clear what I was getting.

If you want a high quality, compact umbrella that can hold its own against models costing 5x the price, look no further.

title: Good Quality for the Price!
text: First off, I have been using this umbrella for about a year (based in NY so not on a daily basis).  It is very sturdy against wind and has yet to flip inside out at any point.  Material feels much stronger than any of those cheap umbrellas you find in the junk stores.  Some people may not find it to be a very light weight umbrella but I don't see that as a big deal because I expect that from an umbrella you don't want to fall apart after one use.  To open you press the button and it opens with no problem!  To close you press the button and it closes the umbrella but you must push the umbrella back down to make it compact again.  Pushing the umbrella back down requires some strength.  That being said, it may not be easy for someone who is weak.  It would probably not be easy for someone like my grandmother.  Overall I think it was a great purchase for the price!

title: Not sterling silver!
text:
*UPDATED REVIEW*
When I initially reviewed this necklace, I was misunderstanding things a bit. The packaging of this necklace said the product was rhodium plated and I assumed I was paying for a piece of jewelry that potentially wasn't sterling silver. What I didn't know was that rhodium-plating is actually used on stuff like sterling silver, white gold and platinum because it adds brightness, shine and resistance to tarnish! Which is an added bonus, but it might be something to consider adding to the product description as a potential selling point so people who don't do their research don't make fools of themselves. :)

title: I went ahead and gave it to my friend anyway and she loved it. So it would have been 5 stars ...
text: I bought this as a gift for a friend. I was trying to find a replacement for a larger version of this bracelet that my friend had that she had worn out because she wore it all the time. I wish the seller had have put the width measurement in the description as when it arrived it was much smaller than I was expecting as the pictures looked the same as the one, my friend already had. I went ahead and gave it to my friend anyway and she loved it. So it would have been 5 stars with a better or more informative description by the seller. I did have to shorten the bracelet bu four rows of balls to fit my friend's wrist but I knew that would need to be done before I bought it. If the bracelet is too long for your wrist and you don't shorten it will snag on something at some point and be easily damaged. The balls in the bracelet are only connected with a small gage piece of wire and any stress on the ends of the wire will cause the wire to pull out of the ball. The durability of the bracelet will be fine as long as you don't snag the bracelet accidentally. The bracelet is made in Italy and the quality is as good as it gets.

title: Absolutely LOVE fit and value!
text:
I've been searching for a comfortable summer shoe, that is also nice looking. It's hard to find styles out there that are both. I keep finding get something really strappy, that are cute, but they either aren't appropriate to wear to work, have no support whatsoever, or look like something my grandmother would wear! These are simple, lightweight and extremely comfortable. I wear them to work with my nice pants and have been very pleased. I'd love to have these in brown also. They would be a staple for summer wear.

I will say that they do run a tad bit small. Depending on the shoe, I usually wear a 6 1/2, but they didn't have half sizes, so opted to order them in a 7. They fit perfect. I don't have any issues with trying to keep my feet in them, like some sandals.

On the outside of the top strap, there is a Velcro style buckle. This is good if you are a little wider in the mid-portion of the foot, as you can loosen it a bit, if needed. Keep in mind, leather always stretches. So if they do seem a tiny bit tight, just know that they will stretch.

title: Very pretty, easy to adjust, and easy to see watch face.
text:
My only negative about this watch was the crystal. For the price it should be synthetic Sapphire, not mineral crystal. I scratch watches, I bang them on desks, walls, doors, just about anything I walk near seems to magnetically draws my watch to impact. It’s not like I expect real Sapphire, just synthetic. Those never scratch no matter what I hit. Quartz crystals scratch typically on the first day. The mineral crystal should last a while, but sooner or later it’ll scratch.
The things I like about it far outnumber the bad
I like how easy it is to adjust the band. I have 2 or 3 watches sitting around collecting dust because I have either gotten too big or too small for them. Yeah I’m lazy. If it doesn’t fit I’ll never remember to bring to the store to have it adjusted. So this band that you just lift the bracket, slide the band and then clamp it down again is super adjustable.
I like the modern look, with easy to see hour markers. I hate those ones where you have to guess at whether it’s pointing at 4 or 5 o’clock because they think its cool to just have a blank face with 2 hands. It’s a watch, it should easily tell time.
I like the band’s feel. It is nice and smooth and won’t pull out any hair on your arm.
Overall it’s a very pretty, functional watch at a decent price.

Now onto what you really care about- BUY IT. I think I’m going tighten to the rings holding the heart & axe, but overall, OUTSTANDING work.
SO beyond words excited & pleased with this purchase!! Probably my favorite purchase on Amazon!

SSDGM, everyone!

title: Best box you can buy for 25 bucks.
text:
For the price I paid at $25 I won't dock any stars.

Pros
The see though case is glass, it looks like leather, the contrast stitching looks very sharp, the box itself feels study, the hinge doesn't hit any watches, plenty vertical clearance when closing the case, the latch is satisfying, the compartmentalized drawer is very useful.

Cons
The pillows feel like they are made out of paper or some sort of fiber that looks like it can rip.
The hinge could be a point of failure so I do treat it delicately.
Internal construction is made of thick cardboard that is lined with a felt-like material.
Top padded "leather" is very thin and feels like it can rip from the slightest scratch. I rather they kept it consistent with the rest of the box.

Closing thoughts:
Great box for a new collector but if you want your box to last as long or longer than your watches better to go spend 70+ for a solid wooded box.
